prompt: You are starting a dense textbook chapter. Which first step is most likely to improve your comprehension as you read?

options.text: Start at the first line and read straight through without pausing
Skim the headings and the end-of-chapter questions first, so you know what to look for
Read only the final summary and skip the chapter itself
Memorise the glossary before reading anything else

explanation: Previewing the structure gives your reading a purpose: you know the main questions in advance, so key points stand out instead of arriving as an undifferentiated stream of text.
